changed: Device Sync writes less to your device's storage when a sync has nothing new: it now updates its record of what your devices share only for the items that changed, instead of rewriting all of them on every sync.

added: `SyncBaselineEntry.hasSameHashesAs(other)` says whether two baseline entries carry the same wire hash, body hash and body-hash version.
changed: `SyncLocalRepository.advanceBaseline` and `replaceBaseline` write their entries in one batch rather than one statement per entry. The rows they leave are unchanged.
